```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[very thick, line cap = round]
    \def\Lx{2*pi}
    \def\Ly{4}
    \def\h{0.75*\Ly}

    \draw[dashed,samples=10,variable=\x,domain=-2:2]
        plot(\x,{\h*\x*\x/4});
    \draw[mydarkblue,samples=100,variable=\x,domain=-\Lx/2:\Lx/2]
        plot(\x,{\h*(sin(deg(\x/2))^2)});
    \draw (0.01*\Lx,\h) -- (-0.01*\Lx,\h) node[left] at (0,\h) {$2$};

    \draw[->] (-\Lx/2,0) -- (\Lx/2,0) node[right] {$\eta$};
    \draw[->] (0,0) -- (0,\Ly) node[right] {$\omega(\eta)$};
    \node[mydarkblue] at (0.4*\Lx,0.2*\Ly) {$2 \sin^2(\eta/2)$};
\end{tikzpicture}
```
